name: code-orchestrator
description: Portable phase planning and multi-phase repository delivery adapted from Rob Cheung's Code Orchestrator.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and deliver reviewable repository phases.
interface.longDescription: Writes implementation-ready phase plans and coordinates bounded implementer and reviewer roles while preserving the repository's scheduler, validation gates, and delivery policy.
defaultPrompt: Turn this approved design into a phased implementation plan.
Execute this phase plan through implementation, review, and final validation.
